⚓ Navigation Guide

⚓ PortMasters Rules

🚢 Objective:
Travel 8 voyages, accumulate wealth and reputation!

📦 Goods System:
Raw Materials: Hemp(3 to 6💰), Silk(6 to 10💰), Tea(10 to 14💰)
Finished Goods: Linen Clothes(30 to 42💰), Cotton Clothes(50 to 65💰),
Brocade(70 to 90💰), Sachet(95 to 120💰)

👥 Artisan System:
• Weaver (8 Gold/Voyage): Makes Linen Clothes or Cotton Clothes
• Master Weaver (12 Gold/Voyage): Makes Linen Clothes, Cotton Clothes or Brocade
• Sachet Maker (20 Gold/Voyage): Makes Sachets

🧾 Tax System:
• VAT: 5% on finished goods profit margin
• Income Tax: 10% on voyage net profit

🔮 Broker's Whisper:
• Phase 1: Click "Broker's Rumor Board" to open the window
• Spend 5 Gold to buy a "rumor" about Phase 2 demand
• Every revealed rumor guarantees its matching order appears in Phase 2

🔧 Ship Modules:
• Phase 4: Upgrade your ship to unlock Module Slots
• Draft powerful modules to create unique synergies
• The module offer batch may be changed once per voyage
• Swap modules to adapt to your current run!

🌊 Voyage Phases:
1. Port Purchase: Buy resources at ports (+ Broker rumors)
2. Trade Transaction: Complete orders
3. Maintenance: Pay upkeep fees & process production
4. Upgrade: Improve ships and install modules

⌨️ Shortcuts:
• Ctrl+S: Save Game
• Ctrl+N: Next Phase
• Ctrl+H: Manage Artisans
• Ctrl+R: Restart
• F1: Instructions

⚓ Bon Voyage and Good Luck!
